cr_data.provenance: Doris Marguerite Brixey (died ca. 1984), New York; bequeathed to the Yale University Art Gallery, New Haven, Conn., 1984 (Source: Yale University Art Gallery, 2025)
remarks_1999: This is not a picture of Ranchos Church. Whitney Archive (American Art Research Council Questionnaires) and Abiquiú Notebooks note backing inscription and indicate, "Shown at An American Place, 1932." See cat. no. 1807. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999:
The incorrect title of *Ranchos Church* came from the previous owner, Doris M. Brixey, who incorrectly completed a questionnaire form about the painting in 1946. The back of the painting has "Near Alcalde, New Mexico" written in the artist’s hand. 
Source: 1989 letter from Alexandra Arrowsmith to the Curator of American Paintings and Sculpture in which Arrowsmith details her research into the painting and consultation with Doris Bry, confirming the title should be *Near Alcalde, New Mexico*. (Source: Yale University Art Gallery, 2025)

description: A light brown adobe church with a short, white steeple and a white doorway stands behind a low adobe wall. Dark brown hills dotted with green bushes appear in the distance behind the church. A bright blue sky stretches out overhead.
title: Near Alcalde, New Mexico
